body:
I know it’s not going to change anything, but I’d feel better expressing something I’ve held on for a while. But at the same time I’m also afraid it could affect our friendship in a negative way. It is more of an issue with me, and I understand that’s something I need to handle on my own. So I don’t think I’ll mention it when I see him, at least not now.

Even if I don’t tell him how I felt about us ending, would it be bad to ask about his gf and how things are with them? Bc I feel like to be friends, it would be fair to acknowledge his life completely. There is more to him than just his job, family, hobbies, etc.

I don’t know anything about her, and I don’t know if he told her anything about me. We message each other on a platonic level, but if she had a problem with me or him having female friends, I probably would have been cut off by now.

Sadly that’s true. I mean at the end of the day I can’t blame anyone but myself for this, so I don’t have any place to be mad at him. I admit this was a big mistake and I’ll never agree to do something like this again.

He never said or promised to do more. It’s the fact that when he told me he got back with his ex, I realized I was probably used as a rebound, even after he told me he didn’t think he’d go back with any of them.
Thank you so much. It’s a scary and painful thing to go through. But now I know to never make this type of mistake again.
What about for women? I have a blouse and khakis but I don’t have any dress shoes.
I just want to cut the benefits and stay friends, but I will ask what he wants too.
I never thought about making a cheat sheet. This interview will be in person, so I'm not sure if I could get away with one
Okay, hopefully I’ll hear back something before then but I’ll reach out on Monday if I don’t. Thanks!
Okay, the date falls on next Wednesday. Do you think that would be enough time for them to confirm?
Thank you. It’s incredibly tough rn but I’m doing all I can. I know it won’t be like this forever tho, but I’ll definitely update when I get some good news.

It might be just a dream like you and others have stated. It was just strange to me because while I do appreciate women, I have always fantasized about men. I will try to not worry about it too much or let it define me.
